slice_analysis.interpretation: Neither latest rule improves every subgroup. Scale-half loses to full on empty-history and 1-16 history AUC/Logloss, and frequency_1_2; it also loses on hour_12_18. Scale-adjacent wins only 11/23 AUC slices against scale-half but has lower Logloss in 18/23. Full-population AUC includes cross-slice ordering and is not a weighted mean of slice AUCs. Empty-history changes can arise through shared learned parameters despite identical empty-history handling.

candidate_diagnostics.scope: Candidate-authored, first 512 ordered validation impressions at each frozen selected checkpoint; not an independent population or training-gradient audit.
candidate_diagnostics.observed_checks: Each latest arm reports 60475 valid/eligible events, 508 nonempty rows, 4 empty rows and 506 rows with >=4 eligible events; zero natural floor/boundary events. Fixed-state full-versus-active product/logit maximum errors and padding/empty-summary errors are zero. Weight sums and conserved scale/squared-scale sums differ by about 1e-7.
candidate_diagnostics.synthetic_checks: Reported two VJP probes per mode across ten modes with synthetic boundary/floor cases, scaled errors <=3.61e-15 and zero forward difference. Candidate-written probes do not independently establish training-gradient correctness or all device/dtype/boundary states.
candidate_diagnostics.interpretation: At the scale-half checkpoint, rank-adjacent scale correlation is about +0.899 versus -0.345 for rank-half, with mean age gaps about 48405 versus 125347 seconds. Rank-half also has larger own/donor scale differences. Its numerical AUC win therefore does not support a monotonic positive-correlation or temporal-locality explanation. These statistics are downstream of training and cannot measure mediation. Conserving scalar moments does not conserve total gradient norm, shared-embedding accumulation, update energy or Adam state.

observations.statement: Feature-only, pooled and target-aware reference AUCs are 0.6050036145, 0.6102261137 and 0.6133619861; history additions reduce Logloss. This establishes useful predictive history signal without identifying a semantic limitation.
All 39 allowed model trials succeeded and have null errors; previous_runtime_error is null. Scientific negative and abandoned branches remain evidence; no unseen execution failures are invented.
Full count correction reduces pooled and DIN AUC. Half correction helps pooling by 0.0005804055 but reduces DIN AUC by 0.0002082243; partial correction did not rescue this target-aware branch.

Aligned raw products improve the ordinary product adapter by 0.0011629547 AUC; the ordinary adapter itself remains slightly below original DIN. Removing only off-diagonal products also helps, so both restrictions cannot receive undivided credit. Same-seed round-4/raw bridges reproduce these aggregates.

Unit normalization helps aligned AUC by 0.0004876568; crossed unit normalization barely changes AUC and worsens loss. Aligned exceeds crossed at equal unit norm, weakening a solely explicit product-magnitude explanation but leaving field/coordinate/optimization explanations.

Full aligned derivative exceeds detached, tangent-only and identity surrogate AUC in the original gradient factorial, but fixed 0.2 tangent and identity surrogates later approach the full result. Exact adaptive scale or projection necessity is not established.

Whole-history mean retains AUC near full/fixed but worsens Logloss. Chronological half-rotation loses AUC; action mean and action-half controls do not rescue it. Chronological adjacent recovers AUC in both groupings. Retain the negative branches and the rule-specific nature of that recovery.
The latest chronological-half bridge exactly reproduces r0009-history_reassigned AUC, Logloss and all slices. It is a deterministic lineage check, not a new seed.

Inverse-norm rank adjacent and half have AUCs 0.6150251061 and 0.6151021885. Scale-half exceeds the previous incumbent by 0.0001034468, full by 0.0001204973 and fixed by 0.0001133430; its Logloss also improves against all three. Scale-adjacent has the lowest recorded Logloss 0.1965201288. Both latest leaders remain seed-42 exploratory results.

Chronological adjacent-minus-half AUC is +0.0002689085; rank adjacent-minus-half is -0.0000770824. The rank-minus-chronological interaction is -0.0003459909. Rank ordering improves both offsets, more strongly for half. Adjacent has lower Logloss than half in both orders, so AUC and loss do not share the same ordering interaction.

The latest rules retain 17130275 parameters, including 51587 dense parameters; wall times are 635.69 and 639.45 seconds and peak memory 835099136 bytes. Cost is measured descriptively; equal parameter counts/data passes do not establish equal compute.

interpretations.statement: The supplied ordering-by-offset factorial gives provisional local evidence that the allocation of backward scale across events matters under this fixed forward model; a universal penalty for half-rotation is inconsistent with the newest rankings.
interpretations.qualification: Conditional on receipt-described common forward and isolated derivative. One training seed and adaptive validation reuse; no repeated mechanism support.

interpretations.statement: The earlier adjacent recovery cannot be attributed simply to temporal proximity or high positive own/donor scale correlation. The rank-half AUC leader uses a more distant, negatively correlated donor in the sampled diagnostics; positive correlation is not a demonstrated necessary condition for this numerical recovery.
interpretations.qualification: No monotonic correlation or distance mechanism has been isolated. Rank, tie handling, recipient direction and shared optimizer effects remain coupled.

interpretations.statement: Rank-based reassignment may alter scale-to-gradient-direction coupling or act as regularization while preserving the scalar scale distribution. Neither explanation is identified; negative correlation itself is not established as beneficial.
interpretations.qualification: No measured training gradients, gradient norms, update trajectories or fixed-state population probes. Scale moments do not match optimizer dynamics.

interpretations.statement: Action membership alone was already inadequate to explain the chronology-half penalty; the new whole-history rank result does not establish a special multi-behavior semantic interaction or repair of action imbalance.
interpretations.qualification: The rank-by-offset factorial varies order within histories, not action grouping, so no rank-by-action or higher-order interaction is identified.

interpretations.statement: Scale-half is the current primary-metric incumbent and scale-adjacent is a relevant quality/cost alternative, but neither has demonstrated reliable superiority across seeds, all slices or held-out data.
interpretations.qualification: Metric disagreement alone does not establish calibration; slice counts and uncertainty remain material.

falsifiers.future_falsifying_evidence: Nonpositive paired mean AUC versus full/fixed or unstable seed effects weaken superiority; subgroup losses already refute uniform benefit. No equivalence/significance threshold can be inferred from these aggregates.

falsifiers.current_status: Unsupported; accumulated gradient directions, shared parameters and optimizer moments are unmatched.
falsifiers.future_falsifying_evidence: Differences in fixed-state accumulated gradient norms or update norms directly invalidate that exclusion.

limitations: Only seed 42 is observed. Deterministic replays are not independent repetitions. Adaptive validation reuse can inflate selected differences; no statistical significance, equivalence, noninferiority or repeated mechanism support.

Actual sources/checkpoints/raw data/individual predictions are not exported. Hashes and notes preserve provenance but do not independently verify identical construction, initial tensors, data order, checkpoint policy or backward isolation.

New factorial uses stable inverse-norm ordering and two deterministic offsets, not random independent donor contrasts. Rank ties, temporal distance, behavior membership, scale correlation and scale-direction pairing remain coupled. No optimal radius or causal temporal/semantic mechanism is identified.

Scale first/second-moment conservation leaves accumulated gradient norms, optimizer moments and update energy unmatched; group means remove variance. New rules hold projection fixed and do not identify projection-by-rank or action-by-rank interactions.

Candidate-authored diagnostics cover first 512 ordered impressions with only four empty histories and no natural floored/boundary events. Two synthetic probes per mode are bounded checks, not independent training/device/dtype verification.

All 23 overlapping slices are exploratory. Exposures are not independent users; cluster intervals are unavailable. Missing/unseen full-population slices and untruncated histories beyond the 128-event cap are unobserved.
AUC/loss tradeoffs alone do not diagnose calibration. Aggregate AUC is not a weighted average of slice AUC. Empty-history differences may arise through shared learned embeddings.

The ordinary product adapter differs numerically from original DIN despite exact bridges. Published DIN omits attention-output softmax; this local masked-softmax reference is an adaptation, not an exact reproduction.
Publisher static user/ad snapshot dates are undocumented. Readiness and causal/scorer checks are inherited from the frozen host protocol; no independent production point-in-time guarantee.

Equal parameters and passes do not imply equal compute. Allocated GPU seconds, exact training examples processed, repeated latency benchmark, equal-compute frontier and actual closed-scoring costs are not exported.

All exposed trials succeeded operationally; scientific negative outcomes and abandoned count/crossed/identity/action-mean branches remain recorded. Preparation harness/retrieval issues are distinct from model failures and remain charged.

Closest external normalization/surrogate-gradient prior work remains unverified. Empty bounded registry search does not establish novelty. Industry cards are external reports, considered but not implemented; no transfer or causal knowledge-value claim.

Only analysis.json is editable now. Source/config identities and aggregate reproduction are provided; executable training commands and source/checkpoint verification require a later authorized interface. Proposed memory updates are not claimed as committed memory.
